content: Claude 2026 release notes show no native send-to-another-user's-Claude feature. Relevant shipped items: connector file transfers beta (2026-11-24, directory connectors only), interactive connector apps on mobile (2026-03-25), memory for all users incl. Free (2026-03-02), Cowork on web/mobile (2026-07-07), Claude tagging in Slack for Team/Enterprise (2026-06-23). ChatGPT comparison: shared projects on all plans incl. Free and group chats rolled out late 2025. Source: support.claude.com 12138966 fetched 2026-11-27 (summarized by fetch model).
